computation-library-root.name: InverseGamma_noaoa
computation-library-root.description: Equity ESG using Inverse Gamma model without AOA calculation

columns.c:
if\s!apply_inner_loop_vol\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\sinv_gamma_params.V_0[$index]
 end
 
 if\s$index\s==\s0\sthen\s//\sSPX
 \s\s\s\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped\s=\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped_init
 elif\s$index\s==\s1\sthen\s//\sMXEA
 \s\s\s\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped\s=\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped_init_mxea
 elif\s$index\s==\s2\sthen\s//\sRTY
 \s\s\s\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped\s=\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped_init_rty
 else\s//\sNASDAQ
 \s\s\s\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped\s=\sequity_diffusion_variance_unclipped_init_nasdaq
 end
 return\siif(run_shocksos,\ssqrt(abs(equity_diffusion_variance_unclipped))\s/\sComputation[step].xi[$index],\sinv_gamma_params.V_0[$index])

if\srun_shocksos\sthen
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 endif
 
 K\s=\sS[0]\s*\s(1\s+\sbinary_strike[$index])
 Si\s=\sS[0]
 K_epsilon\s=\sK\s*\s0.99
 T\s=\s1\s/*\s1\syr\soption\sprice\s*/
 r\s=\sswap_rate_1y
 k_average_1y\s=\sComputation[step].k_average[0]
 spx_theta\s=\sComputation[step].theta[0]
 lambda_average_1y\s=\sComputation[step].lambda_average[0]
 xi_average_1y\s=\sComputation[step].xi_average[0]
 q_average_1y\s=\sComputation[step].q_average[0]\s-\sComputation[step].funding_spread_average[0]
 put_price_at_K\s=\sinverse_gamma_option_price(Si,K,r,T,k_average_1y,\sspx_theta,\slambda_average_1y,\sxi_average_1y,\srho_idx_vol[0],\svol[0],\sq_average_1y)
 call_price_at_K\s=\sput_price_at_K\s+\sSi*exp(-q_average_1y*T)\s-\sK*exp(-r*T)
 put_price_at_K_epsilon\s=\sinverse_gamma_option_price(Si,K_epsilon,r,T,k_average_1y,\sspx_theta,\slambda_average_1y,\sxi_average_1y,\srho_idx_vol[0],\svol[0],\sq_average_1y)
 call_price_at_K_epsilon\s=\sput_price_at_K_epsilon\s+\sSi*exp(-q_average_1y*T)\s-\sK_epsilon*exp(-r*T)
 
 return\s100\s*\smax(0,\scall_price_at_K_epsilon\s-\scall_price_at_K)\s/\sK
